milestones.title: Estimated populations near the world's nuclear plants for Nature

sources.title: A GIS analysis of the number of people living near each of the world’s nuclear power plants

milestones.title: Co-led a public explanation of PLACE III population and elevation data

milestones.title: Taught primary geospatial data collection at Black Rock Forest
milestones.summary: Joined a three-course field excursion teaching GIS and remote sensing through GPS, mobile mapping and balloon-borne aerial cameras at Black Rock Forest.

milestones.title: Co-led development of SEDAC’s global COVID-19 viewer
milestones.summary: Co-led development of a global COVID-19 viewer combining case data with population age and sex estimates for user-drawn areas.

sources.title: Global COVID-19 Map Viewer Shows Case Data, Age/Sex Features of At-Risk Populations

milestones.title: Co-authored research on urbanization and Jamaica Bay storm tides

sources.title: Students Take the Driver’s Seat in Drone-Enabled Geospatial Data Analysis

milestones.title: Led a global study of coastal-population exposure and data uncertainty
milestones.summary: First and corresponding author of a study testing how elevation, population and settlement-data choices affect global estimates of people exposed to coastal hazards.
